node-1.label: Initial gastroscopic examination revealed lesions in the gastric antrum

node-2.label: A 52-year-old male presented on July 10, 2019 with an unremarkable past medical history

node-3.label: The patient underwent laparoscopy-assisted distal gastrectomy and Billroth II gastrojejunostomy on July 23, 2019, followed by eight cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy with SOX regimen (oxaliplatin + tegafur, gimeracil and oteracil potassium) and 25 doses of radiotherapy in May 2020

node-4.label: During treatment, the patient experienced grade II neutrophils, grade I nausea, grade I neurotoxicity, grade II diarrhea with weight loss, rash, pruritus, and grade II oral ulcer
